dialogues.jp: 「どっか寄るのも、かったるいしなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I don't feel like going anywhere today......"
dialogues.text: "I don't feel like going anywhere today......"

dialogues.jp: さっさと帰るか……。
dialogues.en: I guess I should just go home.
dialogues.text: I guess I should just go home.

dialogues.jp: 鞄片手に、廊下へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I grabbed my bag and went out into the hallway.
dialogues.text: I grabbed my bag and went out into the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 校門の先に、まっすぐのびる桜並木が見える。
dialogues.en:
I can see right down the straight avenue of cherry blossoms
outside the gate.
dialogues.text:
I can see right down the straight avenue of cherry blossoms
outside the gate.

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜の花びらの中を、学生たちが歩いて
いく。悪くない――どちらかというと、綺麗な
風景だが……。
dialogues.en:
Students are walking down the avenue along with the falling
petals of cherry blossom. It's not too bad...... Actually
it's an extremely beautiful view.
dialogues.text:
Students are walking down the avenue along with the falling
petals of cherry blossom. It's not too bad...... Actually
it's an extremely beautiful view.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ毎日見てると、感動も薄れるよな」
dialogues.en:
"...But I'm getting tired of seeing this view every day. I'm
not that impressed anymore."
dialogues.text:
"...But I'm getting tired of seeing this view every day. I'm
not that impressed anymore."

dialogues.jp: 鞄を肩にのせ、のんびりと歩く。
dialogues.en: I rested my bag on my shoulder and walked slowly.
dialogues.text: I rested my bag on my shoulder and walked slowly.

dialogues.jp: おやっ？
dialogues.en: Huh?
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩ッ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.jp: 声をかけると同時に、駆け寄り、隣に並ぶ。
dialogues.en: As I called her, I sped up my pace to get next to her.
dialogues.text: As I called her, I sped up my pace to get next to her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも」
dialogues.en: "Hi."
dialogues.text: "Hi."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「これからお帰りですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going back home?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going back home?"

dialogues.jp:
舞い散る桜の花びらの向こうで、萌先輩が静か
に微笑む。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai smiled in the rain of petals.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai smiled in the rain of petals.

dialogues.jp: 「ええ。萌先輩もですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Are you going home too?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Are you going home too?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
満面の笑みに安心して、俺にあわせて歩き始め
た萌先輩と並んで、校門を抜ける。
dialogues.en: "Shall we walk together?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we walk together?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「今日は約束はしてませんので、一緒じゃない
　んです」
dialogues.en: "Sure, why not?"
dialogues.text: "Sure, why not?"

dialogues.jp: それは静かでいい。
dialogues.en:
I felt at ease looking at her smile. Moe-sempai started
walking along at my pace, and we went out through the gate.
dialogues.text:
I felt at ease looking at her smile. Moe-sempai started
walking along at my pace, and we went out through the gate.

dialogues.jp: （ま、両手に花も悪くないけど）
dialogues.en: "Where's Mako today?"
dialogues.text: "Where's Mako today?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あら、眞子ちゃん」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not with her today because we don't have any planned
engagements."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not with her today because we don't have any planned
engagements."

dialogues.jp:
怒涛のごとき勢いで、眞子が息を切らして走っ
てきた。
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
ぜえはあ、と肩で息をしている様子からすると
かなり遠くからダッシュしてきたらしい。
dialogues.en: That's good. I get to enjoy a peaceful time with you.
dialogues.text: That's good. I get to enjoy a peaceful time with you.

dialogues.jp: 「いったい、どこから走ってきたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
(Although, it's not too bad to have two girls by my
side......"
dialogues.text:
(Although, it's not too bad to have two girls by my
side......"

dialogues.jp: うげっ！
dialogues.en:
Surrounded by the scent of cherry blossoms, I walked side by
side with Moe-sempai on the avenue.
dialogues.text:
Surrounded by the scent of cherry blossoms, I walked side by
side with Moe-sempai on the avenue.

dialogues.jp:
じゃあ、音楽室からここまで、この短時間で追
いついたのか。
dialogues.en: Petals are landing on Moe's hair, uniform, and xylophone.
dialogues.text: Petals are landing on Moe's hair, uniform, and xylophone.

dialogues.jp: なんつー驚異的な体力。
dialogues.en:
"Even though it's small, isn't it hard to walk with a
xylophone in your hand?"
dialogues.text:
"Even though it's small, isn't it hard to walk with a
xylophone in your hand?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。でも早く上手になりたいですか
　ら、いつも歩きながら練習しているんです」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, it is. But I want to be good at it, so I practice
while I walk."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, it is. But I want to be good at it, so I practice
while I walk."

dialogues.jp:
手にした木琴を持ち直し、マレットで鍵盤を叩
きはじめる。
dialogues.en:
She repositioned the xylophone in her hand and started
hitting the keys.
dialogues.text:
She repositioned the xylophone in her hand and started
hitting the keys.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の叩く、独特な木琴の音が辺りに響く。
dialogues.en: The unique sound of her xylophone echoed around us.
dialogues.text: The unique sound of her xylophone echoed around us.

dialogues.jp:
（なんと言うか……いつ聴いても味のある音色
　で……）
dialogues.en:
(How can I put this in words......? Her tone sounds so
unique......)
dialogues.text:
(How can I put this in words......? Her tone sounds so
unique......)

dialogues.jp:
練習しても、素でこれだけ外れた音を出せるの
は、ある意味才能だと思う。
dialogues.en:
She has talent in a way. How can she be so off, after
practicing so hard with it?
dialogues.text:
She has talent in a way. How can she be so off, after
practicing so hard with it?

dialogues.jp:
眞子はもう慣れているらしく、止めようともし
ない。
dialogues.en:
I continued to walk down the street with this xylophone girl
while people stared at us.
dialogues.text:
I continued to walk down the street with this xylophone girl
while people stared at us.

dialogues.jp: ◆路上で木琴を叩く萌先輩◆
dialogues.en: ◆Playing a xylophone in the street◆
dialogues.text: ◆Playing a xylophone in the street◆

dialogues.jp:
校舎を出たところで、萌先輩の姿を見かけた。
横に並んで、一緒に帰る事にする。
dialogues.en:
I saw Moe-sempai when I got out of school. We decided to
walk home together.
dialogues.text:
I saw Moe-sempai when I got out of school. We decided to
walk home together.

dialogues.jp:
道すがら、早く上達したいからと、木琴を叩く
萌先輩であった。
dialogues.en:
Moe practiced her xylophone while walking down the street
because she wanted to be better with it.
dialogues.text:
Moe practiced her xylophone while walking down the street
because she wanted to be better with it.
